tools.description: Create a new record. Omitted top-level fields receive declared server defaults. Present values including null, false, zero, empty containers and empty strings are preserved. Nested objects are not populated with additional defaults.
tools.name: create_record
tools.title: Create Record

tools.description: Update an existing record using JSON Merge Patch object semantics. Missing members are unchanged; null removes a member; objects merge recursively; arrays and scalars replace. No default values are inserted. This fixture accepts the same algorithm under both declared media types.
tools.name: patch_record
tools.title: Patch Record
